risks.title: Difficult post-merger integration
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned recurrently in the document, notably around integration of Codan Norway and Trygg-Hansa. Language is affirmed ("intense work", "challenging year"). Trend is upward as integration efforts are ongoing. Industrial category is central to Tryg.

risks.title: Increased online competition
risks.score_rationale: Document emphasizes rising online sales and competitive pressure, particularly in Sweden. Tone is strategic and concerned. Trend is upward. Competition category is heavily impactful.

risks.title: Dependence on auto partnerships
risks.score_rationale: Partnership with BMW and Tesla is highlighted as growth driver. Language is positive but reveals dependency. Trend is stable. Key sectoral risk for motor business.

risks.title: ESG regulatory pressure
risks.score_rationale: Tryg obtains ISO 14001 and EMAS certifications, showing strong regulatory requirement. Language is proactive but implies costs. Trend is upward. Regulation category is central.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of integrated systems
risks.score_rationale: Integration of new IT systems post-merger increases attack surface. Not explicitly mentioned but implicit in technology risks. Trend is upward. Technology category is critical.

risks.title: Declining customer retention
risks.score_rationale: Document mentions increased churn in Q4 2022, notably among single-product customers. Language is measured but concerning. Trend is upward. Reputation category is impacted.

risks.title: Swedish market concentration
risks.score_rationale: Trygg-Hansa is now leader on certain products in Sweden, but market is consolidated. Language is neutral to positive. Trend is stable. Competitive risk is moderate.

ai_positioning.summary: Tryg is progressively integrating artificial intelligence into key processes such as underwriting, claims management and fraud detection, without making it a primary strategic lever.
